question.text: Which of the following statements about SEBI's review of a PPM submitted by a Category III AIF is TRUE?

answer.text: SEBI approves the PPM after due diligence
SEBI provides observations on the PPM but does not approve the document
SEBI certifies factual correctness of the PPM disclosures
SEBI ratifies the PPM jointly with the Merchant Banker

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Section 5.6, SEBI explicitly states that submission of the PPM should NOT be construed as approval — SEBI only issues observations. **The Trap:** The Merchant Banker (not SEBI) provides the due diligence certificate. SEBI does not certify correctness of disclosures. **Cross-Exam Context:** Same position applies to Cat I/II PPMs in XIX-A — SEBI consistently disclaims approval for all private-placement documents. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Train investor-facing teams to avoid saying 'SEBI-approved PPM' — call it 'SEBI-registered Cat III AIF' instead to stay accurate.
